```python
files = search_files_by_filename('client-meeting-minutes.docx')
if len(files) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No file found with the name 'client-meeting-minutes.docx'.")

file = files[0]

class MeetingSummaryModel(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    next_meeting_date: str
    client_email: str

meeting_info = query_ai_assistant(
    "Read the following document content. Summarize the main points for the client in a professional tone. Identify and extract the date of the next meeting in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Also, provide the client's email address if mentioned in the document.",
    MeetingSummaryModel
)

send_email(
    recipients=[meeting_info.client_email],
    subject='Summary of the client meeting',
    body='{}\n\nThe next meeting is scheduled for {}.'.format(meeting_info.summary, meeting_info.next_meeting_date),
    attachments=[{'type': 'file', 'file_id': file.id_}],
    cc=None,
    bcc=None
)
```
